title: 2013 Panini Prestige #49 Trent Richardson Cleveland Browns Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2013 Panini Prestige sports trading card features Trent Richardson, a former Cleveland Browns player who played football in the NFL. The card is part of the 2013 Panini Prestige set and has a card number of 49. It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection, especially for fans of the Browns or Richardson. The card is not autographed and is not vintage. It was manufactured in 2013 by Panini Prestige, a well-known sports trading card manufacturer. This item falls under the categories of Trading Card Singles and Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop.
